From Greg Wischer at the United States Department of the Interior:"The statue of Baron Friedrich Wilhelm von Steuben in Lafayette Park was cleaned and waxed by the National Park Service. His 1779 training manual, known as the "Blue Book," became the Army's first standardized training manual.
